description:
List future expiration dates for a ticker's listed options.

    Excludes past expirations. Use the result as input to get_options_chain.
    Also use it FIRST when the user asks for greeks, IV or delta on a
    ticker's options: the chain it leads to is the data we can present.

    Args:
        ticker: Underlying ticker (e.g. 'AAPL').
name: get_options_expirations
